up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human target CHEMBL215 (Polyunsaturated fatty acid 5-lipoxygenase). The query must join activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, and molecule_dictionary. Filter for: 1) Target CHEMBBL215 (ensure organism is Homo sapiens/tax_id 9606 and target_type is SINGLE PROTEIN if applicable based on target_dictionary). 2) Activity type is IC50. 3) Standard relation is '='. 4) pChEMBL value is not null. 5) Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. 6) Limit to 1000 rows. Output columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), standard_type (from activities), and pchembl_value (from activities).
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type AS target_type, td.tax_id AS tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type AS standard_type, a.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL215' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
